| [AM.MAN.GRIP.1] <a id="am-man-grip-1"></a> | [TacClaw-Infinity: A Large-Scale Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.20320v1)<br>Fucai Zhu et al<br>**Tags:** `dataset` `gripper` `tactile` `umi` `robot-free-collection` `bimanual` `structured-annotation` `cross-embodiment` `real-world` | **Type:** Primarily a VTLA dataset, with a tactile UMI-style collection interface and processing methods.<br>**Construction:** Record synchronized vision, touch and end-effector motion without the target robot, with language descriptions; curate trajectories and annotate contact phases, subtasks and target objects.<br>**Scale/release:** Paper reports 10,000+ hours, 1M+ episodes and 1,000+ task types. The official portal advertises an initial 1,000-hour subset; replay/kinematic tools are public, while policy training/evaluation code is forthcoming.<br>**Evaluation scope:** TacClaw is a handheld gripper interface, not an articulated multi-finger hand. Two policies, π0.5 and StarVLA, are tested on three bimanual tasks across Tianji Marvin M6S Lite, RealMan RM75-b and DM-Sparky One, using 1,600 demonstrations and 50 trials per task.
